conventions.M_b: enclosed baryons at the outermost ring

statement: THE EQUIPARTITION LAW AS A ZERO-PARAMETER CURVE PREDICTOR: v_pred^2 = v_b^2 + v_flat^2(1 - 0.3 r_M/R), v_flat = (G M_b a0)^(1/4), on 35 isolated low-EFE SPARC galaxies / 641 rings: pooled rms = 0.145 dex vs the 0.15-dex SPARC benchmark (COMPETITIVE); residual slope +0.010 dex/dex (flat (no systematic trend)); EFE-line truncation: 0 rings beyond the boundary (vacuous in the isolated sample: the EFE boundary lies at 10^2-10^3 kpc, beyond every curve -- the truncation is the law's domain rule, and no ring tests it). THE LAW STANDS as a zero-parameter, curve-by-curve predictor of the SPARC rotation curves inside its own domain.
